description.value: River Stone Estate Winery is a small, family-owned estate winery perched on a rocky knoll in the South Okanagan, just south of the landmark McIntyre Bluff and north of Oliver — BC's self-styled Wine Capital. The winery is celebrated for big, bold Bordeaux-style reds and aromatic whites grown on deep glacial rock and gravel soils at River Rock Vineyards. Cyclists riding the Oliver wine route can stop at the open-air tasting garden, with walk-ins welcome or bookable tasting sessions available.
